components.name: assetize
components.interface: 输入工程材料，输出 proposal.md + assets/ + manifest.json；CLI: skills/assetize/scripts/validate.py <dir> [--strict]

components.name: asset-ai-ize
components.interface: 输入 approved asset record + 目标环境，输出 build 包；CLI: skills/asset-ai-ize/scripts/validate_build.py <dir> --assets-repo <path> [--release]

components.name: ai-infra-feedback
components.interface: 输入组件问题描述/会话证据，输出脱敏 Markdown/JSON 反馈单与 staging 候选；--send 需 --yes

components.name: engineering-agent-skill
components.interface: 复杂任务编排入口：分类→澄清→计划→任务包→验收→写回；Step 1 澄清结果落 reports/<task>/clarification.md 并被计划以 requirement_card 引用；scripts/task_packager.py validate --strict

components.name: grill-me-with-doc
components.interface: D1–D6 六问判定（目标/约束/输入/输出/边界/验证标准）决定是否澄清；触发时落盘 reports/<task>/clarification.md；由 engineering-agent 澄清阶段调用

components.name: session-distiller
components.interface: 会话蒸馏：scan/extract/worker；worker.py 消费 ~/.claude/self-evolve/queue/jobs.jsonl，写 staging 候选

components.name: engineering-agent
components.interface: Claude Code subagent：接收复杂任务，按五步流程委派与验收；Step 1 按 D1–D6 判定并在澄清时强制产出 clarification.md，计划以 requirement_card 引用；frontmatter 不写 model（该字段可选，inherit 在本环境不可解析，缺省即用平台默认）；依赖 engineering-agent skill

components.name: engineering-agent-hooks
components.interface: SessionStart 环境提示 + UserPromptSubmit 复杂度预分类；fail-open 旁路，不是强制门禁

components.name: self-evolve-hooks
components.interface: SessionEnd 入队 enqueue.py（无 eval、JSON 解析、L0 阈值）+ SessionStart 提醒；runtime 目录 ~/.claude/self-evolve

components.name: self-evolution
components.interface: 采集→蒸馏→分诊→人工确认→晋升→召回/卫生；设计文档安装到 ~/.claude/self-evolve/DESIGN.md

components.name: rule-verilog-filelist-sync
components.interface: R1：Verilog 文件变更必须同步 filelist；filelist 自动 hook 尚未实现，需人工核查

components.name: rule-no-auto-external-actions
components.interface: R3：对外上传/推送/提交/发布必须人工确认；配套 gate.py external-write PreToolUse 拦截

components.name: rule-verify-or-review-before-delivery
components.interface: R4：交付前执行方自查 + 独立复核双证据；配套 gate.py acceptance 聚合

components.name: rule-subtask-acceptance-checklist
components.interface: R7：子任务必须携带可逐项判定验收；配套 task_packager.py --strict

components.name: rule-no-raw-records-in-memory
components.interface: R8：原始记录不得写入长期记忆；配套 gate.py memory 检查

components.name: memory-asset-taxonomy
components.interface: EA-01：9 领域平铺 + 2 项目正交 + 四层级的资产分类体系

components.name: task-packager
components.interface: 任务包 new/validate/list；validate --strict 检查类型/枚举/依赖/路由/独立验收

components.name: gate-core
components.interface: 失败关闭门禁 CLI：record/asset-registry/component-registry/plan/acceptance/external-write/memory/task-package/install

components.name: component-schemas
components.interface: approved-record / component-registry / acceptance / plan / install-manifest 的 JSON Schema 契约

components.name: installer
components.interface: 按 registry 安装/备份/回滚组件；写 install manifest；memory 写 MEMORY.md 受管区块

components.name: docs-domain-taxonomy
components.interface: 9 领域 slug、公共/领域/项目/个人四层级的落位规则

components.name: sample-rule-bist-scan-same-cycle
components.interface: EA-08 synthetic 示例：bist_en/scan_en 同周期互斥；仅用于流程演示，不得安装

components.name: sample-memory-hbm3e-stack-repair
components.interface: EA-09 synthetic 示例：stack-level repair 决策；仅用于流程演示，不得安装

components.name: authority-model
components.interface: 三仓权威源、开发源、公共分发与转换职责说明

components.name: runtime-support
components.interface: 当前受测运行时/安装/门禁强制范围矩阵

components.name: pilot-evaluation-template
components.interface: 真实资产消费试点前后基线与复盘模板

components.name: asset-consumption
components.interface: 资产检索→适用性→版本固定→消费验收→反馈流程

components.name: asset-lifecycle
components.interface: 资产退役、替代、拆分合并与多消费者台账流程
